import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    claims = inputs["claims"].copy()
    
    # Initialize output dataframes
    claims_fast_track = pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    claims_high_value = pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    claims_manual_review = pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    claims_standard = pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    
    # Track which rows have been matched
    matched = pd.Series([False] * len(claims), index=claims.index)
    
    # Rule 1: amount <= 500 and photos_attached == 1
    rule1_mask = (claims["amount"] <= 500) & (claims["photos_attached"] == 1) & ~matched
    claims_fast_track = pd.concat([claims_fast_track, claims[rule1_mask][["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]]], ignore_index=True)
    matched |= rule1_mask
    
    # Rule 2: amount > 10000
    rule2_mask = (claims["amount"] > 10000) & ~matched
    claims_high_value = pd.concat([claims_high_value, claims[rule2_mask][["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]]], ignore_index=True)
    matched |= rule2_mask
    
    # Rule 3: photos_attached == 0 or amount > 500
    rule3_mask = ((claims["photos_attached"] == 0) | (claims["amount"] > 500)) & ~matched
    claims_manual_review = pd.concat([claims_manual_review, claims[rule3_mask][["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]]], ignore_index=True)
    matched |= rule3_mask
    
    # Default port: unmatched rows go to standard
    default_mask = ~matched
    claims_standard = pd.concat([claims_standard, claims[default_mask][["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]]], ignore_index=True)
    
    # Reset index for output dataframes
    claims_fast_track = claims_fast_track.reset_index(drop=True)
    claims_high_value = claims_high_value.reset_index(drop=True)
    claims_manual_review = claims_manual_review.reset_index(drop=True)
    claims_standard = claims_standard.reset_index(drop=True)
    
    return {
        "claims_fast_track": claims_fast_track,
        "claims_high_value": claims_high_value,
        "claims_manual_review": claims_manual_review
    }
